comment.narrative: The project team was in the process of selecting capable and knowledgeable BDS service providers to support UDB in building a pipeline of bankable young agripreneurs and agriSMEs. This support would have included providing technical assistance and capacity development to preselected 50 young agripreneurs and 67 agriSME clients with the aim of preparing them for potential funding from UDB. However UDB management decided not to proceed with this BDS support. If the preselected SMEs had received the appropriate business development services it is likely that a higher percentage of them would have met the criteria for UDB funding.
